text: Program Emphasis Automobile Marketing, Automobile Insurance, Automobile Assessment Main Courses Mechanical drawing, Electronic Technology,Theoretical mechanics, Material, Engine Mechanics, Car infrastructure, Automobile theory, Automobile electrical equipment, Automobile Application Engineering, Automobile Marketing, Automobile Maintenance Engineering, Automobile insurance and Claims Settlement, Vehicle Assessment and Evaluation. Duration 4 years Degree Awarded With necessary credits, those who have passed all the required courses and met the requirements for graduation of the university will be awarded bachelor's degree and diploma. Career Opportunity Graduates will be capable to work in management team within big companies , organizations and institutions specialized in automobile marketing , automobile Insurance , automobile assessment and maintenance
